title: 8. The Sumerians - Fall of the First Cities
summary: Episode 8 of the Fall of Civilizations podcast, a roughly two and a half hour history of the Sumerians. It covers their mysterious origins, invention of writing and mathematics, great early cities and eventual collapse, with myths, proverbs and recreated music.
why: HN commenters strongly recommend it as an audiobook-length, deeply informative introduction to Sumer and early Mesopotamian civilization.

quote.text: I highly recommend the _Fall of Civilizations Podcast_ episode 8.
